headline: Colonials Carry Callahan's Post as Weathered Expanse Battle Rages
war_summary: The Colonials have taken another post in Callahan's Passage, where the tally now reads nine works Warden to one Colonial against ten held at the previous filing. That sector remains the war's furnace: 552 Colonial and 372 Warden casualties in the latest hour, both rising, and twenty-one events across the day, seventeen of them about Crumbling Post. In the Weathered Expanse the Warden hold has thinned again to one work of nine, six Colonial and two unclaimed, with fifty-four events in twenty-four hours and the heaviest bloodshed on the map. Nevish Line stands dead level at four works apiece and is the freshest storm, twelve events in six hours and three in the last two. Kuura Strand, boiling at the last edition, has gone quiet this watch; Palantine Berm stirs only faintly. Across 436 counted works the Colonials hold 313, the Wardens 119, and four lie unclaimed. No victory is declared on this, the 533rd day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
